Name: Quality Machines
Author: chazmosis
Description:
Adds a number of new craftable machines to your game!  Each of these machines, while they work like the existing machines, will carry the quality of the base resource through to the completed artisan good.  In addition, if you put in a Large Milk/Goat Milk/Egg or a Dinosaur Egg, you'll get multiple returned artisan goods.

This mod requires Custom Farming Redux by Platonymous, which itself requires a number of mods. Make sure you install all of the prerequisites for this to work.
